facts.text: I provided a confirmation hearing notice for a Chapter 11 bankruptcy case involving Cred Inc. and its subsidiaries.
The notice states that on January 21, 2021, the Bankruptcy Court entered an order granting interim approval of the disclosure statement.
The notice says the combined hearing to consider final approval of the disclosure statement and confirmation of the plan is scheduled for March 9, 2021 at 2:00 p.m. prevailing Eastern Time.
The notice says the combined hearing is before the Honorable John T. Dorsey, United States Bankruptcy Judge.
The notice says the combined hearing is in the United States Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware at 824 North Market Street, Wilmington, Delaware 19801.
The notice states that due to the COVID-19 crisis, the combined hearing may be conducted remotely.
The notice states that the voting record date is January 14, 2021.
The notice states that holders of claims in Class 4 (General Unsecured Claims) and Class 5 (Convenience Claims) are entitled to vote on the plan.
The notice states that the voting deadline is March 1, 2021 at 4:00 p.m. prevailing Eastern Time.
The notice states that the debtors’ voting agent is Donlin Recano & Company, Inc.
The notice states that the voting agent must receive the ballot by the voting deadline for the vote to be counted.
The notice states that holders of claims in Class 1, Class 2, Class 3, Class 6, and Class 7 are not entitled to vote on the plan.
The notice states that if a creditor disagrees with the amount listed on a ballot, the creditor may contact debtors’ counsel to try to resolve the matter.
The notice states that if agreement cannot be reached, a creditor may file a Rule 3018(a) Motion for an order temporarily allowing the claim in a different amount for voting purposes.
The notice states that all Rule 3018(a) Motions must be filed on or before the 7th calendar day before the voting deadline.
The notice states that a creditor’s ballot will not be counted except as may be otherwise ordered by the court if a Rule 3018(a) Motion is filed.
The notice provides a phone number for Donlin Recano & Company, Inc. as (877) 739-9988.
The notice provides an international phone number for Donlin Recano & Company, Inc. as (212) 771-1128.
The notice states that objections to final approval of the disclosure statement or plan confirmation must be filed in writing and served with proof of service.
The notice states that objections must be actually received no later than 4:00 p.m. prevailing Eastern Time on March 1, 2021.
The notice provides counsel addresses and emails for objections, including Paul Hastings LLP in Houston, Texas and New York, New York.
The notice provides counsel addresses and emails for objections, including Cousins Law LLC in Wilmington, Delaware.
The notice provides counsel addresses and emails for objections, including McDermott Will & Emery LLP for the creditors’ committee in New York, New York.
The notice provides U.S. Trustee contact information in Wilmington, Delaware for objections.
The notice states that failure to file and serve an objection in conformity with the procedures may result in the objecting party not being heard at the hearing.
The notice states that the combined joint plan and disclosure statement and related documents may be examined free of charge at https://donlinrecano.com/clients/cred/Index.
The notice states that the combined joint plan and disclosure statement are also on file with the court and may be viewed at www.deb.uscourts.gov.
The notice states that to access documents on the court’s website, a PACER password and login are needed and can be obtained at www.pacer.psc.uscourts.gov.
The notice is dated January 22, 2021 in Wilmington, Delaware.
The notice is signed by Scott D. Cousins of COUSINS LAW LLC as co-counsel.
The notice lists the debtors as Cred Inc. (8268), Cred (US) LLC (5799), Cred Capital Inc. (4064), Cred Merchant Solutions LLC (3150), and Cred (Puerto Rico) LLC (3566).
The notice states the debtors’ mailing address is 3 East Third Avenue, Suite 200, San Mateo, California 94401.
